paras: 11 Days Jaipur-Ajmer/Pushkar-Kumbhalgarh-Udaipur-Jodhpur & Jaisalmer Tour Package
Tour Code #DR066
Rs.23199/- per person
Day 01 – Arrival in Jaipur
Jaipur also known as Pink City, it fascinates with its royal palaces, famous forts, and colorful markets. Experience the royal glory and cultural prosperity of Rajasthan's capital.
Upon arrival at Jaipur Railway station/Airport, our representative will greet you. Check-in at the hotel. Relax and in the evening, explore modern attractions of the Pink City:
Statue Circle - Iconic Monument in Jaipur
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium - Hub of Cultural Events
Vidhan Sabha - Legislative Assembly of Rajasthan
Birla Mandir - Marble Splendor in Jaipur
Jawahar Kala Kendra - Artistic Hub of Jaipur
Enjoy a Rajasthani dinner with folk dance and cultural music at a rural atmosphere resort. Overnight stay in Jaipur.
Day 02 – Jaipur Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore the old Pink City:
Hawa Mahal - Palace of Winds Architectural Marvel
City Palace - Royal Residence of Jaipur
Observatory / Jantar Mantar - Historic Astronomical Instruments
Jal Mahal - Palace in the Middle of the Lake
Amer Fort - Ancient Hill Fort Grandeur
Nahargarh Fort & Places - Scenic Fort with History
In the evening, witness the spectacular Light & Sound show at Amer Fort. Overnight stay in Jaipur.
Day 03 – Jaipur to Ajmer/Pushkar
Ajmer: A spiritual hub, Ajmer is home to the revered Ajmer Sharif Dargah. Experience the city's rich religious heritage, bustling markets, and serene Ana Sagar Lake.
Pushkar is renowned for its sacred Pushkar Lake and the Brahma Temple, Pushkar is a vibrant pilgrimage site. Enjoy the lively Pushkar Camel Fair and the town's bohemian vibe.
After breakfast, proceed to Ajmer and Pushkar. Check-in at the hotel and visit:
Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chisti at Ajmer - Sacred Sufi Shrine in Ajmer
Lord Brahma Temple at Pushkar - Hindu Pilgrimage Icon
Overnight stay in Pushkar.
Day 04 – Pushkar to Kumbhalgarh to Udaipur

After breakfast, journey towards Udaipur via Kumbhalgarh. Kumbhalgarh is famous for its formidable fort and expansive walls, Kumbhalgarh stands as a testament to Rajasthan's martial legacy. Explore the UNESCO World Heritage site and its intricate architecture.
Kumbhalgarh Fort - Majestic Fortress of Rajasthan
Arrive in Udaipur, check-in at the hotel. Overnight stay in Udaipur.
Day 05 – Udaipur Sightseeing
Udaipur also known as the "City of Lakes," it enchants with its serene waters, grand palaces, and romantic atmosphere. Visit the exquisite City Palace and enjoy a boat ride on Lake Pichola.
After breakfast, explore the Lake City's highlights:
City Palace - Royal Residence by Lake
Pratap Smarak - Memorial to a Hero
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal - Cultural Museum
Saheliyon ki Bari - Garden of the Maidens
Jagdish Temple - Sacred Hindu Shrine
Bagore ki Haveli - Historic Mansion on Lake
Shilp Gram - Crafts Village
Fateh Sagar Lake - Scenic Water Body
Overnight stay in Udaipur.
Day 06 – Udaipur to Mount Abu Sightseeing

Mount Abu is Rajasthan's only hill station, Mount Abu offers a refreshing retreat with cool climate, lush greenery, and scenic viewpoints. Visit the famous Dilwara Temples and enjoy the peaceful Nakki Lake.
After breakfast, proceed to Mount Abu:
Delwara Temple - Exquisite Jain Temples
Vedi Temple - Spiritual Oasis
Nakki Lake - Tranquil Waterbody
Sunset Point - Mesmerizing Evening Views
Tod Rock - Historical Landmark
Guru Shikhar - Highest Peak in Aravalli
Achalgarh Mahadev Temple - Ancient Temple
Brahma Kumari Ashram - Spiritual Retreat
Overnight stay in Mount Abu.
Day 07 – Mount Abu to Ranakpur to Jodhpur
After breakfast, depart for Jodhpur via Ranakpur:
Ranakpur Jain Temples - Architectural Marvels
Arrive in Jodhpur, check-in at the hotel. Overnight stay in Jodhpur.
Day 08 – Jodhpur Sightseeing

After breakfast, explore the Blue City's attractions. The "Blue City" Jodhpur boasts the majestic fort and a sea of blue houses. Discover its rich history, exciting shopping markets, and scenic views of the Thar Desert.
Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum - Opulent Palace Turned Museum
Jaswant Thada - Memorial of White Marble
Mehrangarh Fort - Impregnable Hill Fort
Clock Tower & Markets - Busy Bazaars
Overnight stay in Jodhpur.
Day 09 – Jodhpur to Jaisalmer

After breakfast, drive to Jaisalmer. Jaisalmer mesmerizes with its yellow sandstone architecture and the magnificent Jaisalmer Fort. Experience desert safaris, ornate havelis, and a glimpse into desert life.
Check-in at the hotel and visit:
War Museum - Memorial of Valor
Gadisar Lake - Artificial Water Reservoir
Vyas Chhatri - Architectural Gem
Overnight stay in Jaisalmer.
Day 10 – Jaisalmer Sightseeing & Desert Experience
After breakfast, explore Jaisalmer:
Jaisalmer Fort & Palaces - Golden Citadel of Rajasthan
Jain Temples - Intricate Marvels of Faith
Patwon ki Haveli - Historic Merchant Residence
Salim Singh ki Haveli - Architectural Grandeur
Nathmal ki Haveli - Craftsmanship in Stone
Experience a night in tents at the sand dunes desert with cultural programs, camel rides, bonfire, sunset, and dinner. Overnight stay at Desert Camp.
Day 11 – Jaisalmer Departure
After breakfast, check out from the desert camp and visit:
Lodhurva - Ancient Abandoned Village
Amar Sagar - Historical Reservoir
Kuldhara - Haunted Village Legend
Later, depart from Jaisalmer Railway station/Airport. (The Tour Ends)
Package Inclusions:
* Daily breakfast
* Air-conditioned car for transportation throughout the journey
* Driver allowance, fuel, parking fees, and all applicable taxes
* Accommodation in 3-star hotels
* Camel Ride, Bonfire, Hi-Tea, Cultural Programs & Vegetarian Dinner at Desert Camp
* Government-approved tourist guide service for sightseeing in Jaipur
* Complimentary accommodation for children below 5 years of age
Package Exclusions:
* Meals other than those specified in the inclusions
* Personal expenses such as tips, telephone calls, and laundry
* Entrance fees to monuments and attractions
* Camera fees
* Any tickets for trains, flights, or buses
* Travel insurance
Things to note
* Prices are quoted per person based on triple sharing.
* Rates may vary during peak seasons such as New Year and Diwali.
